summary: Crisp citrus (grapefruit/orange/lemon) over sugar, with a bergamot floral note, a sour-apple (malic) tartness, and quinine + cut-grass on the finish.

key_pairings.ginger: match made in heaven (shared gingery notes draw out kumquat)

cocktail_notes: Validates Ari's directions: dairy/milk-wash (oleic/milky harmonious), chai/cinnamon/ginger spice, AND olive brine (briney note + Dirty Martini pairing). Chai-milk and olive-brine are two distinct lanes, not one drink.
